title: Astro2Method: Benchmarking LLMs on Machine Learning Method Selection in Astronomy
abstract: arXiv:2610.30282v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) is increasingly used in astronomy, but choosing a suitable method for a scientific problem often requires expertise in both astronomy and ML. Large language models (LLMs) could help astronomers make such choices, yet this ability remains underexplored in existing benchmarks. We introduce Astro2Method, a benchmark of 500 expert-reviewed binary questions from 346 astronomy papers (2024/01-2026/06), based on clear performance differences and complete (Easy) or partial (Hard) explanations from the authors. Across five LLMs, direct prompting achieves 87.50-92.55% accuracy on Easy questions but only 58.87-64.52% on Hard. Using historical papers, neither retrieval-augmented generation nor most agent methods with additional reasoning or retrieval (including ReAct, Self-Ask, and CRITIC) bring consistent improvement. Agents required to search the web improve accuracy mainly when they find the papers the questions are based

translated_title: Astro2Method：评测大语言模型在天文学中机器学习方法选择能力的基准
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）在天文学中的应用日益增多，但为科学问题选择合适的方法通常需要同时具备天文学和机器学习两方面的专业知识。大语言模型（LLM）可以帮助天文学家做出此类选择，但这一能力在现有基准测试中仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了Astro2Method，这是一个包含500道经专家审阅的二分类问题的基准，这些问题来自346篇天文学论文（2024年1月至2026年6月），基于作者给出的明确性能差异以及完整（简单）或部分（困难）的解释。在五个大语言模型上，直接提示在简单问题上达到87.50%-92.55%的准确率，但在困难问题上仅为58.87%-64.52%。在使用历史论文的情况下，检索增强生成（RAG）以及大多数带有额外推理或检索功能的智能体方法（包括ReAct、Self-Ask和CRITIC）均未能带来一致的改进。需要搜索网络的智能体主要在找到问题所基于的论文时才能提高准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出了Astro2Method这一专家审阅的基准，用于评测大语言模型在天文学中为科学问题选择机器学习方法的能力，发现LLM在简单问题上表现良好但在困难问题上准确率显著下降，且大多数检索增强和智能体方法无法带来一致的性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Astro2Method, an expert-reviewed benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to select machine learning methods for astronomical problems, showing that while LLMs achieve high accuracy on easy questions, performance drops substantially on hard ones, and most retrieval-augmented and agent-based methods fail to deliver consistent improvements.
